segments.text: In this video, we're going to be talking about some more physical safety features with the laser.
segments.zh: 在这个视频里，我们要讲激光切割机的更多实体安全功能。

segments.text: So in addition to using approved materials, there are a couple other safety things we're going to ask of you.
segments.zh: 除了使用经批准的材料之外，我们还会要求你们注意另外几件安全事项。

segments.text: The first and most important is that you are required to remain with the laser the entire time it is running.
segments.zh: 第一条也是最重要的一条：激光切割机运行的整个过程中，你必须一直守在旁边。

segments.text: So if the laser is cutting, scoring, or engraving, if the laser is running one of your designs, you are required to be with the laser.
segments.zh: 所以，只要激光切割机在切割、划线或雕刻，只要它在运行你的设计，你就必须守在机器旁边。

segments.text: And to define that a little more, we want you within arm's reach and where you can see inside of the laser.
segments.zh: 再具体一点说，我们希望你在伸手可及、并且能看到机器内部的位置。

segments.text: So it's okay if you're standing here on your cell phone, if you're making your next design using the computer.
segments.zh: 所以，你站在这里看手机，或者用电脑做你的下一个设计，都没关系。

segments.text: We're not saying you have to be here staring into it the entire time.
segments.zh: 我们不是说你必须一直站在这里盯着它看，

segments.text: But we do want you within arm's reach so you can notice if something goes wrong.
segments.zh: 但我们确实希望你在伸手可及的范围内，这样一旦出问题你能注意到。

segments.text: And we don't want you on the other side of the room chatting with your buddy, or getting ready with your next sewing design,
segments.zh: 我们不希望你跑到房间另一头和朋友聊天，或者去准备你的下一个缝纫设计，

segments.text: or whatever else you might be working on.
segments.zh: 或者忙其他任何事情。

segments.text: Up at the top of the laser, we have our start stop button.
segments.zh: 在激光切割机顶部，有我们的启动／停止按钮。

segments.text: We want you to monitor the laser, and there is never any harm in pausing a design while it's running.
segments.zh: 我们希望你们监看激光切割机，而且在设计运行时暂停一下，从来都没有坏处。

segments.text: So if you're ever concerned, you see something that looks like it might be an issue, you see some sort of small flame,
segments.zh: 所以，如果你有任何担心，看到什么看起来可能有问题的情况，看到某种小火苗，

segments.text: it's entirely okay to just pause the laser and give it a minute and see what happens.
segments.zh: 完全可以直接暂停激光切割机，等一会儿看看情况。

segments.text: And that's part of why we want you as close as we do it, so that you can reach over and just pause the laser if something looks like it's going wrong.
segments.zh: 这也是我们要求你离得这么近的部分原因，这样一旦看起来要出问题，你就能伸手暂停机器。

segments.text: If something has gone very wrong, we do have an emergency stop button back here in the corner.
segments.zh: 如果出了很严重的问题，后面角落这里有一个急停按钮。

segments.text: That's going to be most useful for things like the laser arm has gotten itself stuck, it's trying to move and can't.
segments.zh: 它最适用于这类情况：激光臂卡住了，它想移动却动不了，

segments.text: You hear what sounds like breaking components.
segments.zh: 你听到像是部件断裂的声音，

segments.text: You see some amount of smoke that you're really concerned about.
segments.zh: 你看到一定量的烟，让你非常担心。

segments.text: At this point, I do want to specify any sort of laser cutting, engraving, scoring, any use of the laser is going to produce some amount of smoke and sometimes small flames,
segments.zh: 在这里我要特别说明一下，任何形式的激光切割、雕刻、划线，只要使用激光切割机，都会产生一定量的烟，有时还会有小火苗，

segments.text: and that is to be expected.
segments.zh: 这是正常的。

segments.text: Laser cutting is the process of burning away material, so you do sometimes get small flames and things like that.
segments.zh: 激光切割就是把材料烧掉的过程，所以有时确实会出现小火苗之类的情况。

segments.text: What we want to be concerned about is if those small flames start to turn into larger flames,
segments.zh: 我们需要担心的是，这些小火苗开始变成大火，

segments.text: if the laser moves onto a different part of your design and part of your design is still on fire.
segments.zh: 或者激光已经移到设计的另一部分，而设计的某部分还在燃烧。

segments.text: That is when we want to be concerned and start thinking about hitting either the pause button or the emergency stop button.
segments.zh: 这时我们就要警惕了，要开始考虑按暂停按钮或急停按钮。

segments.text: I tend to default to the pause button first because you can recover your design, you can keep going.
segments.zh: 我通常默认先按暂停按钮，因为这样你的设计还能恢复，可以继续进行。

segments.text: So if the flame sort of blows itself out because of the air movement from the filter, you're good to keep going.
segments.zh: 所以如果火苗因为过滤器带来的气流自己熄灭了，你就可以继续。

segments.text: If you hit the emergency stop button, it turns off the power to the laser, and you will not be able to recover your design.
segments.zh: 如果你按了急停按钮，它会切断激光切割机的电源，你的设计就无法恢复了。

segments.text: So you want to always start with the pause button first, unless you're like,
segments.zh: 所以你应该总是先按暂停按钮，除非你觉得，

segments.text: oh, this something has gone just catastrophically wrong, in which case go straight to the emergency stop button.
segments.zh: 哦，这出了灾难性的大问题，那种情况下就直接按急停按钮。

segments.text: Along with the emergency stop button, we have one other really nice safety feature.
segments.zh: 除了急停按钮，我们还有另一个非常好的安全装置，

segments.text: That is this box right here.
segments.zh: 就是这里的这个盒子。

segments.text: This box is our fire suppression tool.
segments.zh: 这个盒子是我们的灭火装置。

segments.text: So it is actively monitoring the inside of the laser any time the laser is on.
segments.zh: 只要激光切割机开着，它就会持续监测机器内部。

segments.text: It will make noise if it detects smoke and flame.
segments.zh: 如果检测到烟和火焰，它会发出声音。

segments.text: And if it detects an excessive amount of smoke and flame, it will begin to sound like a fire alarm.
segments.zh: 如果检测到过量的烟和火焰，它会开始像火灾警报一样响起来，

segments.text: It will begin to make sort of a whooping sound.
segments.zh: 会发出一种呜呜的声音。

segments.text: It is loud. It is loud because it wants you and others to be aware that something has gone wrong.
segments.zh: 声音很大。之所以很大，是因为它要让你和其他人意识到出问题了。

segments.text: When it goes off, it will do several things.
segments.zh: 它触发时会做几件事：

segments.text: It will turn off power to the laser again, and it will also spray CO2 gas from this box into the laser itself.
segments.zh: 它同样会切断激光切割机的电源，还会从这个盒子向机器内部喷射 CO2 气体。

segments.text: So if you hear this box start to whoop like a fire alarm, what we want you to do is nothing.
segments.zh: 所以，如果你听到这个盒子像火灾警报一样呜呜作响，我们希望你什么都不要做。

segments.text: We don't want you to rush over and open the lid because we want this box to be able to spray the CO2 gas into the laser first.
segments.zh: 我们不希望你冲过去打开盖子，因为我们要让这个盒子先把 CO2 气体喷进机器里。

segments.text: What we do want you to do is make sure staff are aware.
segments.zh: 我们确实希望你做的是确保工作人员知道。

segments.text: They should be because it is going to be pretty loud.
segments.zh: 他们应该会知道，因为声音会很大。

segments.text: But if they are not, wave over a staff member, say, hey, it is making a bunch of noise,
segments.zh: 但如果他们没注意到，就招手叫一位工作人员过来，说：嘿，它一直在响，

segments.text: and then await staff instructions.
segments.zh: 然后等候工作人员的指示。

segments.text: So we don't want you to rush over and open the lid.
segments.zh: 所以我们不希望你冲过去打开盖子，

segments.text: We don't want you to start rushing out of the building yelling fire.
segments.zh: 也不希望你喊着“着火了”冲出大楼。

segments.text: There is no need to panic.
segments.zh: 没有必要惊慌。

segments.text: We do want you to make sure that staff are aware and follow their instructions from there.
segments.zh: 我们确实希望你确保工作人员知道，然后听从他们的指示。

segments.text: In the event that the CO2 gas from our fire suppression box is insufficient,
segments.zh: 万一我们灭火盒喷出的 CO2 气体不够用，

segments.text: on the other side of the laser, we do have a fire blanket and fire extinguisher,
segments.zh: 在激光切割机的另一侧，我们还有灭火毯和灭火器，

segments.text: and those will be used at staff instructions.
segments.zh: 这些会在工作人员的指示下使用。

segments.text: So if staff say, that didn't work, the laser is still on fire, we will move to the next level of suppression.
segments.zh: 所以如果工作人员说，那没用，机器还在着火，我们就会采取下一级的灭火措施。

segments.text: But we really want to let this box go first because this is a lot easier and a lot less mess to clean up.
segments.zh: 但我们真的希望先让这个盒子发挥作用，因为这样简单得多，要清理的烂摊子也少得多。

segments.text: So hopefully none of those things end up being necessary.
segments.zh: 希望这些东西最后都用不上。

segments.text: We haven't had to use them yet.
segments.zh: 我们到现在还没用过。

segments.text: And if you use approved materials and follow some general safety guidelines, you should be in good shape.
segments.zh: 只要你使用经批准的材料，并遵守一些一般安全准则，就应该没什么问题。

segments.text: And hopefully we'll never have to use any of that, but it's good information to have.
segments.zh: 希望我们永远都用不上这些，但了解这些信息是有好处的。

segments.text: In the next video, we'll talk about the software side of things.
segments.zh: 在下一个视频里，我们会讲软件方面的内容，

segments.text: So we'll talk about Extool Studio and setting up your designs.
segments.zh: 会讲 xTool Studio 以及如何设置你的设计。
